name: lab
description: Tutor for the Agent Lab training: an 8-hour hands-on course in AI fluency — going from understanding how agents work to building a full AI system. Four modules of 2h covering the harness and coding agents, RAG and retrieval systems, knowledge graphs and ontologies, and building a full AI system that delivers real value, by building one real-world example and improving it in every module. Start with /lab:start.
